task.title: Creating Your Duosmium Account
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to create your Duosmium Account!

context.p: If you are an event supervisor (ES), you will get an email inviting you to join the tournament. Here's how to do so and create your account.

step.cmd: Click where the email says "click here".
When you get to a page that says "Duosmium Scoring Login", click "Don't have an account?"
